# No internet
Your internet connection is either weak or non-existent!
Please check your internet connection.

et.message:
# Internet puudub
Teie internetiühendus on kas nõrk või puudub üldse!
Palun kontrollige oma internetiühendust.

en.message: This page is currently under development and therefore temporarily unavailable.

et.title: Leht on arenduses

en.title: Welcome!
en.discord: Log in with **Discord Auth** and return to [discord/link](https://extaas.com/discord/link) to grant our [Discord Community](https://extaas.com/discord) bot access to your account.

et.discord: Logi sisse **Discord Auth-ga** ja naase lehele [discord/link](https://extaas.com/discord/link), et anda meie [Discord Community](https://extaas.com/discord) botile juurdepääs sinu kontole.

The page you are looking for does not exist.
How you got here is a mystery.

et.title: Oi-oi! Sa oled eksinud!
et.message:
Lehte, mida otsite, pole olemas.
Kuidas te siia sattusite, on mõistatus.
